operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install --non-interactive
operations.recovery: Keep the repository and installation private. Stop Nook; retain source, private settings and all additive migrations. Use rer export to a private archive, rer import into empty inactive local state, and the documented offline identity mapping before normal sign-in. Compare re-exported records and media. Local proof is not hosted deployment acceptance; see OPERATIONS.md.
